High-performance K-beauty technology meet gentle, effective ingredients for a flawless complexion.

Step 1: 345 Relief Cream Mist (100ml)

An ultra-fine Dual-Layer Mist (Cream + Essence) that locks in all the goodness. Perfect for on-the-go hydration and fixing the skin barrier throughout the day.

Step 2: Vitamin C Boosting Serum (30ml)

A daily brightening powerhouse with 640,000 ppm of Sea Buckthorn Water. It targets melanin and restores vitality without the stinging sensation of pure Vitamin C.

Step 3: 345 Relief Cream (50ml)

Our best-selling Fungal Acne Safe moisturizer. It focuses on recovering skin from acne damage using a potent blend of Niacinamide, PDRN, and Panthenol.

2. Key Point

(1) The Ultimate Climate-Ready Routine

- Zero-Stickiness, Maximum Glow: Each product is optimized for high humidity. From the serum's weightless finish to the mist's micro-distribution, this trio provides a \"glass skin\" look without feeling heavy or greasy.

- 24/7 Care: Use the Serum and Cream for your morning/night foundation, and carry the Mist to combat \"Air-Con Dryness\" in offices or malls.

(2) Proven Clinical Results

- Dark Spot Care: 1.91% Decrease in Melanin Level within 2 weeks. (Vitamin C Boosting Serum)

*Tested by Korea Institute of Dermatological Sciences

3. Especially For

Ideal for those struggling with:

- Persistent Post-Acne Marks: Fading red and brown spots left behind after breakouts.

- Dull & Sensitive Skin: Wanting a brighter complexion with zero irritation.

4. Key Ingredients

- Sea Buckthorn Water (63%): A natural Vitamin C & E bomb for intensive tone care.

- Niacinamide & Tranexamic Acid: A synergy that blocks melanin and refines skin texture.

- Rice Bran Water & Panthenol: Deeply nourishes and strengthens the moisture barrier.

- Centella & Madecassoside: The gold standard for calming irritated, red skin instantly.

*raw material characteristics only

How do Glycolic acid products work? Glycolic Acid can help our skin by hydrating it, smoothing out fine lines and wrinkles, improving our skin tone and texture, reducing the effects of sun damage, brighten the skin, reducing pre size, preventing ingrowing hairs, shed dead skin cells quickly, clear out pores which can help with spots and acne. Advanced Anti-Aging Technology & Multi-Peptide Complex System

- Multiple Peptide Complex Formula - Super Emulsion contains OLAY's signature peptide technology developed over 48 years, promoting 400% collagen and 180% elastin production for visible firming and elasticity improvement
- Proven Active Ingredient Synergy - Combines Retinol for accelerated cell turnover and fine line reduction with Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) for moisture retention, improved skin texture, and reduced redness

Application Protocol & Daily Skincare Routine

3. Follow immediately with Super Emulsion, applying desired amount and gently massaging into skin using upward motions until completely absorbed
4. Use morning and evening consistently for best results, allowing each product to absorb completely before applying subsequent skincare or makeup
5. When using in morning routine, ensure to follow with broad-spectrum sunscreen as retinol can increase photosensitivity
6. For enhanced results, use the complete system consistently, as the toner prepares skin channels for maximum emulsion absorption and effectiveness
7. Monitor skin response during initial weeks and adjust frequency if sensitivity occurs, as active ingredients may require gradual introduction



Benefits & Results

Niacinamide provides additional benefits including improved skin barrier function, reduced inflammation, and enhanced moisture retention. This comprehensive system addresses multiple signs of aging while maintaining gentle, non-irritating formulation suitable for daily use and sensitive skin types.

WHY CHOOSE TRISAFE SKINGUARD?

TriSafe SkinGUARD is a next-gen protective moisturiser designed to care for sensitive, itchy and easily irritated skin. It forms a gentle shield against harmful microbes while restoring moisture and soothing discomfort.

Suitable for adults, elderly, children and pregnant mothers. It is also safe for daily use on eczema-prone skin.

SkinGUARD gives you fast relief, deep hydration and cleaner, healthier skin in one lightweight formula that absorbs quickly without any sticky feel.

KEY BENEFITS

• Eliminates 99.9% of microbes within 30 seconds

• Delivers long lasting protection for up to 48 hours

• Soothes itchy, irritated or eczema-prone skin with non-drying Menthol

• Locks in hydration with ceramides and strengthens the skin barrier

• Moisturises without heaviness or stickiness

• Supports healing on dry, fragile or damaged skin

• Suitable for daily use by adults, elderly, children and pregnant mothers

PROPRIETARY POLYIONENE TECHNOLOGY

SkinGUARD is powered by TriSafe’s Polyionene Technology, a next-gen antimicrobial breakthrough developed with A*STAR. This positively charged macromolecule eliminates 99.9% of germs within 30 seconds and protects against bacteria, fungi and viruses.

Because Polyionene is a large macromolecule, it stays on the surface of the skin and does not enter the bloodstream. This is what makes it gentle and suitable for sensitive skin. The protective effect lasts for up to 48 hours, giving long lasting peace of mind for daily use.

CLINICALLY TESTED AND LAB VALIDATED

SkinGUARD is backed by extensive laboratory testing that confirms its safety, gentleness and fast antimicrobial performance.

HOW TO USE

• Apply on clean, dry skin for best absorption

• Use a generous amount and spread evenly over the affected area

• Massage gently until the moisturiser melts into the skin

• Reapply as often as needed to keep skin comfortable and protected

• Safe for daily use by adults, elderly, children and pregnant mothers

• Feel free to chat with us if you have any questions

WHO IS IT FOR?

• Anyone with itchy, irritated or eczema-prone skin

• Children who struggle with sensitive or easily inflamed skin

• Elderly with dry, fragile or thinning skin

• Pregnant mothers looking for a gentle, soothing moisturiser

• Travellers heading to cold, dry countries who need extra protection and hydration

DTIL Hyaluron Serum, 15ml

DTIL Hyaluron Serum is a day & night intense hydrating serum. It contains 3 different molecule sizes of Hyaluronic acid to well penetrate into the different layers of the skin. Keeps skin supple, smooth and soft throughout the day. Suitable for all skin types including Acne and Oily skin.

Ingredients:

Anti-wrinkle properties – due to its capacity to retain large amounts of water,skinstays moisturized and helps to prevent the development of wrinkles, and fills in already present wrinkles to reduce their appearance.
2) Rose Water: Rosewater helps maintain the skin’s pH balance, and also controls excess oil. It helps reduce the redness of irritated skin, get rid of acne, dermatitis and eczema. Due to its antibacterial properties, rose water also aids in healing scars, cuts and wounds. Rose water helps hydrate, revitalize and moisturize the skin giving it with that refreshed look.

DTIL Apple Stem Cell Serum, 15ml

Product Information:
DTIL Anti-Age Apple Stem Cell serum is a nourishing and cell regenerating day & night serum. Good for skin repair, healing and moisturizing. Suitable for all skin types including eczema skin where it can improve the skin conditioning.

Ingredients:

1) Malus Domestica Fruit Cell:
Malus domestica fruit cell culture extract is a powerful skin care an ingredient that comes from the malus fruit – known as the common orchard apple. It is the first plant stem cell active ingredient on the market whose effect was evaluated on human skin stem cells. It can protect the longevity of skin stem cells, delay senescence of essential cells, increase the vitality of skin stem cells and combats chronological aging.

2) Wild Yam Extract:
Wild yam extract is a widely used anti-aging ingredient. The diosgenin may encourage the growth of new skin cells. Diosgenin has also been studied for its potential depigmenting effect.

3) Hyaluronic Acid:
Anti-wrinkle properties – due to its capacity to retain large amounts of water,skinstays moisturized and helps to prevent the development of wrinkles, and fills in already present wrinkles to reduce their appearance.

4) Hexapeptide:
Research shows that Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 can reduce wrinkle depth by up to 30% over the course of 30 days.
Because Hexapeptide produces similar results to Botox, it’s considered an excellent non-toxic alternative. Creams with this ingredient are designed for topical application, so not only is Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 a non-toxic alternative to Botox, but it’s non-invasive, as well.
Peptides are well known for their moisturizing abilities. Creams and serums containing peptides help combat dry skin because peptides help bind water to the skin.
In addition to water-binding properties, peptides also help improve skin elasticity and the skin’s natural moisture barrier.

5) Pentapeptide: A pentapeptide is a peptide comprised of five amino acids. Demonstrates a positive impact on fine lines and wrinkles. The chain of amino acid peptides creates a response on the skin which triggers collagen stimulation and healthy production of elastin fibroblasts.

DTIL Blanche Anti-Age Bio Cellulose Stem Cell Mask, 3Pcs/Box

The mask sheet is made from natural coconut fibre which are small molecular structure of coconut oil ensures it gets absorbed into the skin easily coupled with its cooling properties and hypoallergenic nature.

Key Ingredients
EGF
Peptide
Plant Stem Cell
Adenosine

1) EGF stands for epidermal growth factor, which is a single-chain, non-glycosylated protein that naturally occurs in our skin cells. Its main purpose is to heal our skin by promoting DNA synthesis and cell proliferation. It have a relaxing effect on your facial muscles, helping to minimize movement and the formation of wrinkles. Peptide also stimulate skin growth and repair, fight inflammation, and protect against UV damage.

4) Adenosine is a yeast derived ingredient that functions as a good soothing and skin-restoring agent. Adenosine has proven anti-wrinkle benefits due to its ability to energize skin's surface so it looks smoother and younger. Naturally present throughout the body, adenosine is a beneficial ingredient all skin types. Adenosine is a necessary substance to heal cuts, scrapes, burns, and wounds. Research also shows it has anti-inflammatory effects through neutrophils. Neutrophils are a type of white blood cell that protects us from infections.
